title: Access, roles & sharing
intro: Pipeline test data only. These photographs and invented example annotations are placeholders, not product screenshots or research evidence. Replace them with verified references before review.

questions.title: How do products let people in *without* creating accounts up front (magic link, guest, identity from SSO/LMS)?
How is access scoped by *content* (share a course / recording with a person or group) instead of by global role?
How do products handle bulk rosters: CSV/LMS import, sync, cohorts that churn until week one?
What is the minimal role set that still has an escape hatch (owner/admin/member/guest + per-item overrides)?
How is access time-boxed (release date, expiry, semester end, view-only links)?
How do products remove login friction and account recovery dependency?
